Now the top is completely sealed with a cap and the orifice at the bottom is opened. Some water comes out from the orifice and the water level in the vessel becomes steady with height of water column being 200 $\mathrm{mm}$. Find the fall in height (in $\mathrm{mm}$ ) of water level due to opening of the orifice.

question: Three objects $A, B$ and $C$ are kept in a straight line on a frictionless horizontal surface. These have masses $m, 2 m$ and $m$, respectively. The object $A$ moves towards $B$ with a speed $9 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$ and makes an elastic collision with it. Thereafter, $B$ makes completely inelastic collision with $C$. All motions occur on the same straight line. Find the final speed (in $\mathrm{ms}^{-1}$ ) of the object $C$.
solution:
After elastic collision,
$$
\begin{aligned}
v_A^{\prime} & =\left(\frac{m-2 m}{m+2 m}\right)(9)+\frac{2(2 m)}{m+2 m}(0) \\
& =-3 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}
\end{aligned}
$$
Now from conservation of linear momentum after all collisions are complete,
$$
\begin{array}{rlrl}
m\left(+9 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}\right) & =m\left(-3 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}\right)+3 m\left(v_C\right) \\
& \text { or } \quad v_C & =4 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}
\end{array}
$$
